quarterly_data.signal: Quantum-Si demonstrated sequencing with detection of 18 amino acids using a developmental kit run on integrated Proteus instruments and continues to expect to demonstrate detection of all 20 amino acids in 2026. CEO: the pace of improvement continues to exceed expectations, and with 18 amino acids detected now there is a potential to deliver all 20 amino acids in the commercial kit at launch.
quarterly_data.figure: 18 amino acids detected on integrated Proteus instruments; all 20 expected to be demonstrated in 2026
